name: Push-up
summary: Hands under the shoulders, body straight, lower the chest to a fist from the floor and press up.
setup: Side-on to the phone at floor level, hands just wider than the shoulders, toes on the floor, body one line. Lower until the chest is a fist-height from the floor, elbows about 45° from the body, and press back up.
brief: Hands just wider than the shoulders, toes on the floor, body one line. Lower until the chest is a fist-height from the floor, elbows about 45° from the body, and press back up.
why: From the side the elbow angle gives depth and the hips should sit on the line from shoulder to ankle; sagging or piking off it is measured directly.
contraindications: Wrist or shoulder pain in the bottom position.

faults.label: Hips sagging
faults.tip: Squeeze the glutes and brace so the body stays one line.

faults.label: Hips piking up
faults.tip: A tent shape shortens the movement; lower the hips to the line.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Elbows flaring wide
faults.tip: Arrow, not T: elbows halfway between tucked and wide.

faults.label: Half reps
faults.tip: Lower until the chest is a fist off the floor; if that is too hard, go to the knees.

faults.label: Head leading the way down
faults.tip: Poking the chin down makes the range look bigger than it is.

guide.surface: Firm floor; a mat under the hands is fine.
guide.cannotSee: The elbow flare — a top-down detail.

points.t: Straight from shoulder to ankle throughout.
Chest a fist from the floor.
